errors.evidence: The description states the value in 2018 was 58.7%, but the chart shows this value corresponds to the year 2019. The label 58,7 is positioned over the bar for 2019, not 2018.
The description states the value in 2020 was 68.1%, but the chart shows this value corresponds to the year 2021. The label 68,1 is positioned over the bar for 2021, not 2020.
The description states the value in 2022 was 62.9%, but the chart shows this value corresponds to the year 2023. The label 62,9 is positioned over the bar for 2023, not 2022.
The description incorrectly associates the labeled values with the years 2018, 2020, and 2022. According to the chart, these values correspond to the years 2019, 2021, and 2023, respectively.

The description fails to mention that the bars for the years 2023 and 2024 are rendered in a lighter shade of blue than the other bars, a visual distinction that often implies that these are projected or estimated values.
